newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Socialist Party wants halt on Vilvoorde.
newsitem.headline: France's Socialist Party wants halt on Vilvoorde.

text.p: The French Socialist Party opposes a plan by Renault to close its assembly plant in Vilvoorde, Belgium, a party representative said on Wednesday.

"The Socialist Party reiterates its opposition to the closure of the Vilvoorde plant and asks the management to halt the procedure to close the plant, to reopen the case and take up negotiations," the representative said after a meeting with a Vilvoorde workers' delegation at the French Socialist Party's headquarters.
The representative said the party would help the Vilvoorde staff representatives have access to the new industry minister.
Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said last week, prior to Sunday's election, that he would ask Renault to study alternatives to allow the plant to remain open.
Renault, which announced the closure in February, reiterated on Wednesday that it was indispensable to cut costs and streamline the company's European car assembly operations.
